scientific_integrity: The infinite Garsia variance bound and Hilbert matrix norm follow analytically; finite numerical checks are corroborative.
scientific_limitations: The exact two norms and their ratio apply only to the logarithmic symbol, do not prove a universal gap or resolve existence of positive unbounded SRKT examples. Unindexed equivalent prior calculations remain a risk.
title: An exact square-root-two SRKT gap for the logarithmic Hilbert Hankel symbol
